scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test:dev && npm run test:theme && npm run test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/wait-api.mjs && npm run dev -w frontend
